messages:
Nina: Huge shoutout to @Kai, @Luis, and @Sana for pulling off the last-minute customer demo this morning — they loved the latency numbers and the fallback worked cleanly. also big thanks to @ops-smith for the late-night GPU switch. corgi gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/corgi-party :corgi: :tada:

Kai: Team effort! couldn’t have without the infra handoff. super proud of how we handled the canary. :raised_hands:

Luis: Aw thanks y'all. coffee on me for anyone at HQ this week ☕️

Sana: Whew. adrenaline but worth it. special shout to @Maya for the last-minute prompt tweak that fixed the edge-case outputs. :sparkles:

Maya: Nice!! love a good rapid iteration. also hey @kudos-bot can we add these names to the monthly kudos list? :slightly_smiling_face:

ops-smith: Happy to help — GPU queue cleared and I left a short note in the incident log with the rollback steps. ping if you want the snippet.

kudos-bot: Added entry to /kudos/2026-03.json: "Demo Rescue — Nina, Kai, Luis, Sana, Maya, ops-smith" :sparkles: :confetti_ball:

Nina: <3 you guys. quick poll — donut run tomorrow morning? vote below. :doughnut:

Kai: yes pls :raised_hands:

Luis: count me in :yum:

Sana: prefer bagels but i'll accept a donut :wink:

Maya: bagels > donuts but i'll bring jam if donuts win :smile:

Nina: Awesome. Party food and kudos documented. end of thread :)
